Night notebook entry from Nera Vale.
I found myself walking through the city of Velora while every clock face showed moonlight instead of numbers.
A bridge clerk told me, "Sky bicycles must ring three glass bells before crossing the amber bridge."
The streets folded upward into the clouds and the clerk disappeared behind a silver door.
I opened my eyes in my own bed. The city, the clerk, and everything described above had occurred only while I was asleep; none of it happened in waking life.
